description: Search MFM public companies, pages and published datasets by keyword, company name, ticker or published ISIN. How a gap between price and long-term part evolved (market, state, S&P 500 sector) and gap with breadth by sector: search «gap evolution» or read /data/evoluzione/gap_evolution.json and /data/evoluzione/sector_gap_breadth.json; a single company follows the gap evolution procedure of the instructions. An empty result means no MFM record matched those words: say that MFM does not publish it under those words and never attribute figures from other sources to MFM. Results contain document identifiers and public URLs; private portfolios and accounts are excluded. SELECTION BY PARAMETERS (for clients that only expose search and fetch): start the query with "screen:" followed by conditions separated by spaces, e.g. "screen: buffett_roe_gross>0.15 buffett_roic_tangible>=12% debt_to_equity<0.8 country=US,DE level=1,2 sort=buffett_roic_tangible order=desc limit=10". Ratios are fractions (0.15 = 15%; "15%" is accepted); options: country=, sector=, industry=, level=1,2,3, developed=true, name=, sort=metric, order=asc|desc, limit=1-25 (default 25), columns=a,b, history=metric,from_year,to_year,threshold[,min_years_above[,max_variability]]. Each result is one company with the requested metrics in the title and text and the fetch id of its complete page. The order is the one chosen by the user: a data selection, never a recommendation. Screening has no monthly quota. The website and connected AI share rolling limits per account and per IP address. Existing account quotas for complete company profiles also apply. Screener: 1 query per minute and 60 per day. Company profiles: 10 opens per minute and 300 per day. The limits use rolling windows of 60 seconds and 24 hours. If you reach a limit, the response tells you how long to wait. Analysis on request: 5 per account per calendar month (UTC). BOND CALCULATOR: search "bond: etf=TLT" or "bond: settlement=2026-11-04; currency=EUR; price=100; 2027-11-04=105". No quota consumed. Choose one annual measure and a fiscal-year window of up to 10 years. Thresholds use decimal fractions, multiples or reporting currency. Variability is maximum minus minimum (percentage points for fractions). Missing years are returned with reasons. Historical bounds require a complete comparable window. Use up to 10 comparable full fiscal years. The result gives the verification level, annual values, mean, highest-to-lowest spread, years strictly above the threshold and the reason for any unavailable measure. A slowdown is lower year-on-year revenue growth than in the previous year, measured on three consecutive verified fiscal years. Rising costs means higher reported cost of sales than in the prior comparable year. The sector percentile ranks the window mean among comparable MFM sector peers. Thresholds for currency amounts are in each profile’s reporting currency. Bank and insurer ratios require a full-year value, a stated definition and a cell reference in the annual filing identified by the profile. These figures show traces of a competitive advantage. They do not establish its cause or duration. Check why they have held up. Descriptive data only. Dividends paid plus share buybacks from the annual cash flow statement, divided by MFM owner earnings for the same fiscal year. The arithmetic mean and years_above_100 use comparable observed fiscal years. The count is strictly above 100%. Missing inputs or nonpositive owner earnings yield null with a reason. Example: screen: history=distributions_owner_earnings,2021,2025,100%,2. Metrics: years_in_profit_5: Profitable years in the last 5; years_owner_earnings_to_debt: Years of owner earnings to repay debt; years_owner_earnings_to_debt_with_commitments: Years of owner earnings to repay debt + commitments; years_earnings_to_debt: Years of earnings to repay debt; years_earnings_to_debt_with_commitments: Years of earnings to repay debt + commitments; shares_change_3y: Change in shares outstanding, 3 years [fraction]; cash_conversion: Cash conversion; interest_coverage: Interest coverage ratio; croe_gross: CROE [fraction]; croe_tangible: Tangible CROE [fraction]; croic_gross: CROIC, gross (adjusted FCF) [fraction]; croic_gross_with_commitments: CROIC, gross (adjusted FCF) + commitments [fraction]; croic_gross_avg_5y: CROIC gross, 5-year average [fraction]; croic_tangible: CROIC, tangible (adjusted FCF) [fraction]; croic_tangible_with_commitments: CROIC, tangible (adjusted FCF) + commitments [fraction]; debt_to_equity: Debt-to-equity ratio, equity excluding OCI; debt_to_equity_with_commitments: Debt-to-equity ratio, equity excluding OCI + commitments; capital_intensity: Capital intensity [fraction]; capex_to_depreciation: Capex ÷ depreciation; fcf_margin: Free cash flow margin, MFM adjusted [fraction]; net_margin: Net profit margin, MFM adjusted [fraction]; owner_earnings_to_assets: Owner earnings to total assets [fraction]: Card owner earnings (metrics.owner_earnings) / closing total assets for the same fiscal year (values.total assets), in the same currency and unit. Only with immaterial non-controlling interests: their equity absent with evidence, zero with evidence, or in absolute value below 5% of positive total equity; their income, when available, in absolute value below 5% of net income for the same year (zero net income allowed only with zero minority income). Otherwise null with a reason. Unchanged numerator, including negatives; consolidated owner earnings are not reconstructed. MFM proxy: all capex treated as maintenance, additional working capital not deducted; neither a guaranteed lower bound nor distributable cash.; owner_earnings_to_assets_avg_5y: Owner earnings to total assets, 5-year average [fraction]: Arithmetic mean of the five annual owner_earnings_to_assets ratios for consecutive distinct fiscal years, all available; otherwise null with a reason. Each ratio requires the same currency and unit for numerator and assets within its year; different currencies across years do not prevent averaging. It is not a ratio of cumulative amounts.; owner_earnings_cagr_3y: Owner earnings CAGR, 3 years [fraction]; revenue_cagr_3y: Revenue CAGR, 3 years [fraction]; revenue_cagr_5y: Revenue CAGR, 5 years [fraction]; buffett_roe_gross: Buffett ROE, gross (income / adjusted capital) [fraction]; buffett_roe_gross_with_commitments: Buffett ROE, gross (income / adjusted capital) + commitments [fraction]; buffett_roe_tangible: Buffett ROE, tangible (income / adjusted capital) [fraction]; buffett_roe_tangible_with_commitments: Buffett ROE, tangible (income / adjusted capital) + commitments [fraction]; roe_gross: Return on equity (ROE) [fraction]; roe_tangible: Return on equity (ROE), MFM tangible [fraction]; roi: ROI [fraction]; buffett_roic_gross: Return on invested capital (ROIC), MFM gross [fraction]; buffett_roic_gross_with_commitments: Return on invested capital (ROIC), MFM gross + commitments [fraction]; buffett_roic_gross_avg_5y: Buffett ROIC gross, 5-year average [fraction]; gross_roic_minus_buffett_wacc: Gross ROIC − Buffett WACC [fraction]; gross_roic_minus_buffett_wacc_with_commitments: Gross ROIC − Buffett WACC + commitments [fraction]; buffett_roic_gross_min_5y: Buffett ROIC gross, 5-year minimum [fraction]; textbook_roic: Return on invested capital (ROIC), textbook [fraction]; textbook_roic_minus_wacc: Textbook ROIC − WACC [fraction]; buffett_roic_tangible: Return on invested capital (ROIC), MFM tangible [fraction]; buffett_roic_tangible_with_commitments: Return on invested capital (ROIC), MFM tangible + commitments [fraction]; buffett_roic_tangible_with_commitments_avg_5y: Buffett ROIC tangible + commitments, 5-year average [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_buffett_wacc: Tangible ROIC − Buffett WACC [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_buffett_wacc_with_commitments: Tangible ROIC − Buffett WACC + commitments [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_buffett_wacc_adjusted: Tangible ROIC + commitments − adjusted WACC [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_wacc_no_premium: Tangible ROIC − WACC, no premium [fraction]; tangible_roic_minus_wacc_no_premium_with_commitments: Tangible ROIC − WACC, no premium + commitments [fraction]; operating_income_cagr_3y: Operating income CAGR, 3 years [fraction]; operating_income_cagr_5y: Operating income CAGR, 5 years [fraction]; owner_earnings_over_assets: Owner earnings / total assets [fraction]; derivatives_change_3y: 3-year derivatives change [fraction]; buffett_wacc: Weighted average cost of capital (WACC), MFM Buffett method [fraction]; buffett_wacc_with_commitments: Weighted average cost of capital (WACC), MFM Buffett method + commitments [fraction]; buffett_wacc_adjusted: Buffett WACC adjusted (derivatives 3y, MFM heuristic scenario) [fraction]; buffett_wacc_no_premium: Buffett WACC, no premium [fraction]; buffett_wacc_no_premium_with_commitments: Buffett WACC, no premium + commitments [fraction]; textbook_wacc: Weighted average cost of capital (WACC), textbook [fraction]

query.description: Short keywords, a company name or a ticker (e.g. "Apple" or "MSFT"; the COUNTRY:TICKER form is accepted only in portfolio lines, not in search). Clients that only expose search and fetch can start the query with "screen:" (selection by parameters) or "portfolio:" (portfolio calculator), with the syntax in the tool description; "quota" returns the remaining account allowances. "market: US" reads one whole market of the open data in one request; "plan: market=US; amount=100; from=2022-01; to=2026-08" runs the accumulation plan simulator (past data).
